title: Respecting Someone's Time
paragraphs: Tariq selalu datang tepat waktu untuk rapat. Ayahnya mengajarkan kebiasaan ini. Ayahnya berkata bahwa terlambat dapat menunjukkan waktu orang lain tidak penting. Suatu hari, mitra bisnis datang terlambat dua puluh lima menit. Mitra itu tidak meminta maaf atau memberi alasan. Tariq merasa lebih kesal dari yang ia kira.

Setelah rapat, Tariq berbicara dengan sopan. Ia menjelaskan bahwa ia mengubah seluruh jadwal siangnya untuk waktu rapat itu. Ia ingin menjelaskan perasaannya tanpa bersikap kasar. Mitra itu meminta maaf dan menjelaskan ada keadaan darurat. Tariq menerima permintaan maaf itu. Ia belajar bahwa menghargai waktu berarti datang tepat waktu dan memberi kabar jujur saat terlambat.
answerKey: Tariq always arrives on time for meetings. His father taught him this habit. His father said that being late can show that another person's time does not matter. One day, a business partner arrives twenty-five minutes late. The partner gives no apology or reason. Tariq feels more upset than he expects. After the meeting, Tariq speaks politely. He explains that he changed his whole afternoon for the meeting time. He wants to explain his feeling without being harsh. The partner says sorry and explains that there was an emergency. Tariq accepts the apology. He learns that respecting time means arriving on time and giving honest news when a delay happens.
